dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000rfhk](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000rfhk) Magnitude 5.7 earthquake at 35.0 depth occurred on Oct 07 2025 3km W of Bwatnapne. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -15.6589 longitude 168.0918. It impacted 16159 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
